text:
incident-bot: 🚨 PAGE: multiple gpu-worker pods entering CrashLoopBackOff with SIGSEGV on /opt/runtime/libtrt_kernel.so

ops-oncall (kyle): I'm looking. Which clusters?

maria (eng-runtime): prod-gpu-a in us-west1 and prod-gpu-b in us-east1. Not all nodes, but similar backtraces in dmesg: `BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference` followed by `trt_kernel+0x1f3`.

ajohnson (sre): seeing elevated 5xx rates for /v1/generate in hosted and some dedicated namespaces. CS reports customers A and D saw failures ~10:05 UTC.

dev-runtime (sophie): paste of pod log:
```
2026-03-15T10:04:21Z runtime[pid=1234] error: segfault at 0 ip 00007f8b4c2f01f3 sp 00007fffae3c9b90
#0 0x7f8b4c2f01f3 in trt_kernel::run()
#1 0x7f8b4c1a7b00 in runtime::execute()
```

maria (eng-runtime): suspect recent TensorRT kernel patch we rolled last night (image tag rr-2026-03-14) — it replaced a custom fused op. Reverting to rr-2026-03-12 helped in staging earlier.

ops-oncall (kyle): mitigation plan: 1) scale down affected pools to 0 to stop customer impact for dedicated; 2) cordon nodes flagged by kubelet for OOM/segfault; 3) block traffic via LB rules; 4) roll back runtime image to rr-2026-03-12 on a small canary.

ajohnson (sre): doing step 1 now: `kubectl -n dedicated set scale deployment gpu-pool-prod --replicas=0` — confirmed scaling.

deploy-bot: Started rollback deployment rr-2026-03-12 -> runtime-service-prod. Build artifacts hash a1b2c3.

dev-runtime (sophie): also capture core dumps before they go away: `kubectl exec -n prod -- ls /var/lib/systemd/coredump || true` — nodes have `coredumpctl` enabled. Asking oncall to `gcore` the PID if possible.

ops-oncall (kyle): cordoning node gpu-node-7 and gpu-node-12. `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7` done. Draining with `--ignore-daemonsets` to evacuate.

maria (eng-runtime): can we get metadata from `/proc/self/maps` and run `addr2line` on trt_kernel symbols after we pull the core? I'll produce a build with debug symbols if needed.

ajohnson (sre): telemetry shows latency drop for unaffected hosts after scaling, but overall 5xx still at 2.1%. Customer-success (linda) pinged: two enterprise customers saw in-flight requests time out ~10:05-10:09.

customer-success (linda): customers notified: "We experienced a partial outage impacting model generation; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary." They're asking for ETA.

maria (eng-runtime): initial hypothesis: incorrect boundary checks in the fused kernel when sequence length > 2048; will test locally.

dev-runtime (sophie): rollback canary reporting stable so far on 3 pods in canary pool.

ops-oncall (kyle): started restart of GPU driver on gpu-node-7 after cordon; grepping system logs indicates `nvidia: loading out-of-tree module` warnings. Restarted and rejoined kubelet -> pods pending.

ajohnson (sre): can we open a support ticket with NVIDIA if kernel module looks bad? Also, collect `dmesg | tail -n 200` from nodes.

maria (eng-runtime): collecting `gdb` backtrace from core. Minimal backtrace points to `fused_attention::compute` boundary check.

dev-runtime (sophie): prepare mitigation patch that adds guard and checks; if rollback holds we can ship immediate patch to dedicated only.

ops-oncall (kyle): uncordon gpu-node-7 after driver restart; node is ready. Will keep cordon on gpu-node-12 until we pull cores.

maria (eng-runtime): note: canary is healthy at +12m. Reverting runtime image seems to have stabilized service. Plan: full rollback to rr-2026-03-12 for prod-gpu pools and continue investigating root cause offline.

ajohnson (sre): customer impact summary draft: "Partial outage between 10:04–10:20 UTC for model generation endpoints in us-west1 and us-east1. Some tenants experienced 5xx and timeouts. No data exfiltration. Services restored after rollback. Postmortem to follow."

customer-success (linda): sending update to customers now.

dev-runtime (sophie): I'll attach the core, backtraces, and offending code snippet to the postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident marked HIGH and assigned P1. Links: runbook_incident_ops/internal/INC-4012

ajohnson (sre): oncall handoff: @ops-oncall (kyle) handing to @maria (eng-runtime) at 10:35 UTC to track root cause and postmortem. Kyle stays until rollback confirmed.

ops-oncall (kyle): leaving a note in PagerDuty and slack. :thumbsup:

maria (eng-runtime): taking over. Creating postmortem ticket and will coordinate with vendor if needed.

dev-runtime (sophie): thumbs up. I'll follow on fixes.

--- end thread ---
